summary: Styles: style models built from library pieces or a brief.

commands.name: style.build
commands.summary: Build a style model from pieces, a collection, a filter or a brief

params.name: filter
params.help: Pieces by composer, source and tag: each a string or null.

params.name: collection_id
params.help: A collection whose pieces make the style.

params.name: piece_ids
params.help: The pieces that make the style, 1 to 5000.

params.name: brief
params.help: A written brief the style is made from.

commands.reply: The job that builds the style; its result holds the style.
commands.example:
style.build name "Bach set"
  filter composer Bach

commands.name: style.rebuild
commands.summary: Build a style again from its source
commands.reply: The job that builds the style again.
